row: Sport Horse Chiropractic | Dr. Mike Adney

Welcome to Sport Horse Chiropractic 🐴

I’m Dr. Mike Adney, an equine chiropractor specializing in helping performance horses move freely, feel better, and perform at their best.
Through my videos, you’ll learn how to recognize mobility issues, stretch your horse safely, and support their long-term soundness.

✅ Want to learn how to stretch your horse like a pro?
Check out my Equine Stretching Masterclass – 26 expert-led video tutorials that walk you step-by-step through my proven stretching system:
👉 EquineStretching.com

📘 Prefer to read instead?
Grab my bestselling book Stretching Exercises for Horses and get immediate access to over 100 pages of step-by-step techniques:
👉 StretchingExercisesForHorses.com

🔔 Subscribe for horse chiropractic content, stretching tips, and real case studies from horses I treat around the world.
